# Texture Lab

> Outil d'effets de texture 100 % navigateur, par Binks Design. Il applique à une image ou une vidéo une pile d'effets réglables — 80 effets en 10 familles (couleur, dither, trame, pixel, shader, grain & matière, VHS & analogique, glitch, distorsion, stylisé), 20 préréglages, opacité et 9 modes de fusion par couche — anime n'importe quel réglage en boucle parfaite et exporte en PNG, JPEG ou vidéo (MP4 via WebCodecs). WebGL2 requis. Aucune clé API, aucun compte, rien n'est envoyé à un serveur.
> Browser-only texture effects tool by Binks Design. It applies a stack of tunable effects to an image or a video — 80 effects in 10 families, 20 presets, per-layer opacity and 9 blend modes — animates any setting as a seamless loop and exports PNG, JPEG or video (MP4 through WebCodecs). Requires WebGL2. No API key, no account, nothing is uploaded.

AI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, OpenCode, browser agents) should use the public JavaScript API window.BinksyAPI in app.html (apiVersion 1): await BinksyAPI.describe() lists the tools; importer({files:[{name,type,dataBase64}]}) the user's image/video first, appliquerPreset, ajouterEffet, reglerEffet, reglerSortie, exporter({format:'png'|'jpg'|'video'|'project'}) → {files:[{name,type,dataBase64}]} (no download unless download:true); errors reject with {code,message}. The same tools are registered as WebMCP tools (texturelab_*) when the browser supports document.modelContext. Setup (WebMCP, Playwright MCP, prompt): mcp/. The UI can also be driven through stable selectors: #file (import), #presets .preset, #lib .tile[data-id], #stack li.layer, #fxPanel, #outPanel, #exportBtn (download). window.TL exists but is internal and unversioned (read-only use advised).
Serve the folder over http (python3 -m http.server) and open app.html (app.html?demo loads the example image); file:// works too.
State: localStorage texturelab.session ({stack, out}) and texturelab.presets; the imported media is auto-saved in IndexedDB (database texturelab-autosave, store media, key source) and restored on reload before the settings. Project file: texture-lab-projet.json.

Golden rule: only work on the user's own files; never deliver the built-in example image instead, never add brand text or visuals without approval.
